final: SELECT c.zoneref, s.insurstat, COUNT(*) AS conservation_records, COUNT(*) * 1.0 / (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM scanconservation AS c2 JOIN sites AS s2 ON s2.zoneregistry = c2.zoneref) AS fraction FROM scanconservation AS c JOIN sites AS s ON s.zoneregistry = c.zoneref GROUP BY c.zoneref, s.insurstat ORDER BY fraction DESC, s.insurstat IS NULL LIMIT 10
